products.title: 7" Circuit Short - Black
products.body_html: Meet your new favorite gym shorts. This minimal, relaxed fit features a 7-inch inseam and a stretchy drawstring waist. It’s intentionally designed to be semi-sheer and features a relaxed, body-skimming fit that pairs perfectly with the rest of the collection. Wear it with the matching Short or Pant for a sweet head-to-toe look you’ll never want to take off.

products.body_html: Your favorite gym shorts just got shorter... This minimal, relaxed fit now comes in a 5-inch inseam and a stretchy drawstring waistband.
